final: SELECT AVG(group_avg) as mean_of_averages, AVG(group_avg - baseline) as mean_exceedance FROM (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) as group_avg, (SELECT AVG(instownpct) FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL) as baseline FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE eventannotm IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eventannotm HAVING AVG(instownpct) > (SELECT AVG(instownpct) FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL)) subquery
